item.title: Lawrence Holiday Farmers Market coming up; SNAP tokens available
item.description: The Lawrence Holiday Farmers Market will return Saturday, and this year, the market is offering anyone in need a hand up through Double Up Protein Bucks. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence’s affordable housing board hopes to consider students, funding and more in forthcoming study
item.description: Lawrence Affordable Housing Advisory Board members today identified topics they hope to see addressed in an upcoming housing study, from the university student rental market to new ways to fund housing initiatives. Continue reading ...

item.title: Community members explore options for North Lawrence at open house
item.description: Community members at a North Lawrence Corridor Study open house Wednesday expressed excitement at investment and infrastructure upgrades but also stressed the importance of protecting the core culture of the neighborhood. Continue reading ...

item.title: Winter Inclusive Market to return this weekend; Phoenix Awards set for Sunday
item.description: Lawrence's third annual Winter Inclusive Market is coming up this weekend, and on Sunday it will feature the Phoenix Awards ceremony, honoring six local artists. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU student art sale to offer creative gifts in an abundance of art forms
item.description: It's hard to say what forms of art won't be available at an upcoming KU student art sale, which will offer a comprehensive array of goodies for winter and holiday shoppers. Continue reading ...

item.title: HeadQuarters Kansas to transition to 988 number only, phase out local phone line
item.description: HeadQuarters Kansas has been reachable at 841-2345 for decades. At the end of this year, that will no longer be the case, and all calls will need to go to 988. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence will remove Watson Park basketball court, prone to flooding, this summer
item.description: The city plans to remove the basketball court in Watson Park, which is prone to flooding, during the summer as part of ongoing construction, and it's not yet clear whether a new court will replace it. Continue reading ...

item.title: End of construction on Iowa Street is in sight; road to fully reopen next week
item.description: Lawrence motorists may have noticed four open lanes on Iowa Street Thursday after almost a year of construction work. There are still a few finishing touches to be made, but the city will fully open the street next week. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school district para had unlawful relationship with student, court documents allege
item.description: A former paraeducator in the Lawrence school district carried out an inappropriate relationship with a middle schooler, and in one instance touched the student against his will, court documents allege. Continue reading ...
